meaning: Teichner: D_{0,1} is slice iff some ribbon J makes D_{0,1} # J ribbon. D_{0,1} is certified non-ribbon (Miyazaki via Abe-Tagami), so a VERIFIED certificate here would be a slice-ribbon counterexample. None was found. This is coverage of the stated box only and is not an obstruction: it does not show D_{0,1} # 8_8 is non-ribbon, nor that D_{0,1} is non-slice.
note: Second partner ever run on D_{0,1}; the first was 6_1 (4.2 h, no certificate, results/teichner_AT_b2len5_detached.json). The partner half of the lemma is discharged: 8_8 has its own verified ribbon certificate. Only the certificate for the sum is outstanding.
